import pandas as pd
from openpyxl import load_workbook

df = pd.read_excel('budget.xlsx', sheet_name='Budget', header=None)
# Expense items are pandas rows 10-21 (Excel rows 11-22)
expenses = df.iloc[10:22, 2]
print('Expense items:')
for cat, item, val in df.iloc[10:22, [0,1,2]].itertuples(index=False):
    print(f'  {cat:15s} {item:15s} {val}')
print('Total:', expenses.sum())

# Confirm formula is stored in the file
wb = load_workbook('budget.xlsx')
ws = wb['Budget']
print('C23 stored formula:', ws['C23'].value)
"
